messages:
alex.wong: kicking off thread for BankCo POC — legal asked for an attestation flow and escrow options for CMKs. they also want to understand latency impact when using HSM-backed keys.
priya: noted. do we have a short explainer for their security team that covers key ceremony, rotation windows, and KMS tunnel options? can share with legal.
jen_sales: BankCo asked if we can do a 2-week POC with a dedicated HSM instance + network tunnel into their VPC. pricing wants a credit for the first 2 weeks if they commit to Dedicated afterwards. is that standard?
marco_eng: technical: dedicated HSM provisioning (customer-managed keys) adds ~12–24h setup for attestation & key import if they require offline ceremony. runtime latency: signing/encrypt calls add ~3–8ms p99 for single-key HSM RPCs, depends on key location and token size. batching not applicable for crypto ops.
alex.wong: are we able to provide an attestation cert (CSP/PKCS#11) and HSM firmware details for their red-team?
priya: yes we can provide an attestation PDF and vendor FIPS/CC certs. sec-bot, can you attach the latest attestation pack?
sec-bot: attaching: FIPS-140-2-report.pdf (redacted), HSM-vendor-attest-2025.pdf — see internal link: https://ok.redwood/sec/attestations
jen_sales: legal also asked about key escrow: they want an option where Redwood holds a wrapped backup of the KEK for disaster recovery but with EKM access controls. can we outline options and associated controls?
marco_eng: options: 1) No-escrow: customer keeps CMK in their HSM, Redwood never holds plaintext or wrapped key material. 2) Escrow with split custody: Redwood holds wrapped KEK parts in HSM-backed keystore; customer must authorize unwrap via API + 2FA (requires SOW). 3) Managed-recovery: Redwood holds an encrypted backup in our KMS but wrapped with customer-provided wrapping key stored in their HSM. each option raises different SLA/billing implications.
alex.wong: perfect. need short bullets for sales → include which options require SOW and which require a monthly escrow fee. jen, can you confirm pricing for managed-recovery?
jen_sales: tentative POC pricing: Dedicated HSM + tunnel = $15k/week (provisioning + support). we can offer 50% credit for the first 2 weeks if they sign Dedicated annual commit within 30 days. escrow management is +$2k/month for split-custody oversight (audit logs + 3 key custodians).
priya: BankCo red-team will request a network diagram and a sample init script for establishing the mTLS tunnel. marco, can you paste a sample iptables/sshcmd or terraform snippet we can share (sanitized)?
marco_eng: paste sample (sanitized):
```
# customer side: open port for tunnel
aws_vpc_endpoint "redwood-hsm-tunnel" {
  service = "com.amazonaws.vpce.redwood-hsm"
  vpc_id  = "vpc-xxxxxx"
  private_dns_enabled = true
}
# mTLS: client cert + route to HSM endpoint
```
note: real snippet will include ARNs and ephemeral cert rotation via our provisioning agent.
alex.wong: also need to answer their security questionnaire Q: "Can Redwood perform key rotation without customer action?" short answer?
priya: we support both: automated rotation (Redwood-managed rotation policy) or customer-triggered rotation (customer rotates in their HSM and re-uploads wrapped key). for regulated customers we recommend customer-managed rotation with audit trail.
jen_sales: snag — they asked if rotation window can be limited to business hours. any constraints?
marco_eng: rotation APIs are asynchronous but you can schedule within a maintenance window; if keys are customer-hosted, rotation is controlled by them so we coordinate. for Redwood-managed keys we can schedule and run within their business hours with runbook steps.
priya: legal needs language for SLAs: if HSM crypto operation latency exceeds our p99 target by >2x for >10 minutes, what remediation do we offer? can we promise credits?
marco_eng: propose: 5% monthly credit for incident impacting >12h across region, or expedited fallback to software-wrapped keys (short-term) while we remediate. need SRE signoff on thresholds.
alex.wong: agree. jen, draft an email with the attestation pack, the three escrow options, sample tunnel snippet, pricing credit offer, and ask for their legal red-team availability next week. cc engineering for any technical follow-ups.
jen_sales: will do. I'll attach the attestation links and pricing sheet. timeline: aim to start tunnel test Mon next week. any blockers?
marco_eng: blocker: need BankCo network whitelist + spare public IP for tunnel endpoint. also if they insist on offline key ceremony, schedule 48h for ops runbook and a possible on-site window.
priya: thanks — I'll queue the security questionnaire responses and label any answers that require co-signed SOW.
alex.wong: thanks team. follow-ups in thread. :thumbsup:
